description: Stern's diatomic sequence. s(0) is 0, s(1) is 1, even terms repeat s(n/2), and an odd term is the sum of its two neighbors in the previous row. An optional modulus reduces the term; zero is rejected. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stern
